items.title: Marc Benioff gets a new operating chief, as Salesforce promotes Miguel Milano
items.description: Salesforce promoted revenue head and former Oracle executive Miguel Milano to role of operating chief.

items.title: Fed Governor Cook says she's 'prepared to act' on rate hike to address inflation
items.description: Cook was part of a 9-3 majority that voted last week to keep the central bank's benchmark borrowing rate in a range between 3.5%-3.75%.

items.title: Etsy laying off 12% of staff in bid to streamline business, position for growth
items.description: Etsy announced the layoffs along with second-quarter earnings.

items.title: Lucid begins 'operational reset' as CEO says EV maker will delay midsize vehicle
items.description: The company didn't provide updated guidance. New CEO Silvio Napoli earlier this year suspended production expectations.

items.title: E.l.f. Beauty sees $50 million windfall in tariff refunds as profits surge 100%
items.description: E.l.f. Beauty received $50 million in tariff refunds during its fiscal first quarter, leading profits to nearly double.

items.title: Lisa Su brushes off Musk's Nvidia commitment as AMD stock sinks after earnings
items.description: The chip giant has been a big beneficiary of the AI boom, with stock trading 132% up so far in 2026.

items.title: SpaceX stock falls 13% as AI spending surge rattles investors and massive share unlock looms
items.description: CEO Elon Musk said SpaceX would hit $1 trillion in annual revenue in 2030 versus a previous forecast of 2031 as he looked to strike an bullish tone.

items.title: Trump admin refunds $100 billion in 'liberation day' tariffs
items.description: The Trump administration has taken steps to effectively re-create the IEEPA tariff regime using other legal authorities. They already face court challenges.

items.title: We're increasing our Eli Lilly price target after another beat-and-raise quarter
items.description: The strength of its GLP-1 business suggests the stock still has more room to run.

items.title: As Warsh and the Fed contemplate fewer meetings, markets brace for potential volatility ahead
items.description: Since taking office in May, Warsh has implemented several measures that reverse decades of Fed culture.

items.title: Wall Street's 'fear gauge' is doing something unusual as stocks hit record highs
items.description: Stocks and the Cboe Volatility Index move together only about 20% of the time.

items.title: How Disney parks are bucking a travel slowdown
items.description: Disney posted record quarterly revenue at its parks division despite a continued slump in international travel to the U.S.

items.title: Google's AI reshuffle: Chief scientist Jeff Dean exits and Demis Hassabis steps down as DeepMind CEO
items.description: Google's AI divisions are getting reshuffled, the search giant announced on Wednesday.

items.title: Iran, Oman say Strait of Hormuz talks in final stages, as Trump again teases a deal being close
items.description: Trump's latest remarks signaling again that a deal with Iran to reopen the Hormuz Strait is close at hand drove oil prices lower and sent stocks soaring.

items.title: Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Democratic Senate primary as voters pivot to the left
items.description: Abdul El-Sayed won the Michigan Democratic Senate primary, setting up a context with former Rep. Mike Rogers in the November general election.

items.title: Affordability is a 'defining challenge' for Americans, with food costs leading the way, report finds
items.description: Many consumers rely on credit cards to pay for everyday expenses, such as groceries, but some can't make the minimum payment, according to a new report.

items.title: Flutter shares plummet on earnings miss and another key leadership change
items.description: FanDuel, Flutter's most important business, has been losing its dominance in market share in the United States.

items.title: Kids Online Safety Act social media safety bill advances in Senate
items.description: The Kids Online Safety Act, a measure aimed at protecting children on social media, advanced to the Senate floor after it stalled in the last Congress.

items.title: Salad and Go files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy after cyclospora fears worsened its challenges
items.description: The upstart salad chain aimed to take on Sweetgreen and expanded rapidly under the ownership of Volt Investment.

items.title: Manager of DRAM memory chip stock trade blockbuster ETF is back with new AI thematic bet
items.description: Roundhill Investments' DRAM became a blockbuster ETF in record time on the memory trade. It's back with a new fund targeting another AI tech theme: photonics.
